observation.command:
cd /workspace; python3 - <<'PY'
p="db/dev_seeds/newsletters.rb"
s=open(p).read()
old='''  5.times do |n|
    Newsletter.create!(
      subject: "Newsletter subject #{n}",
      segment_recipient: UserSegments.segments.sample,
      from: "no-reply@consul.dev",
      body: newsletter_body.sample,
      sent_at: [Time.current, nil].sample
    )
  end'''
new='''  recipient_group = RecipientGroup.find_by(access_method: "all_newsletter_subscriber_ids") ||
                    RecipientGroup.order(:id).first ||
                    RecipientGroup.create!(name: "All newsletter subscribers",
                                           origin_class_name: "User",
                                           access_method: "all_newsletter_subscriber_ids")

  5.times do |n|
    Newsletter.create!(
      subject: "Newsletter subject #{n}",
      segment_recipient: UserSegments.segments.sample,
      recipient_group: recipient_group,
      from: "no-reply@consul.dev",
      body: newsletter_body.sample,
      sent_at: [Time.current, nil].sample
    )
  end'''
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new,1)
open(p,"w").write(s)
print("patched")
PY
